answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable deposit in a shared harbor escrow before it can transact. The deposit vests slowly, like a tide coming in: a small slice unlocks each week of honest behavior, and any proven fake identity forfeits the whole bond to the agents it harmed. Creating a thousand sock puppets then costs a thousand deposits, while one genuine agent pays once. The open meadow of public attestations lets anyone audit who vouched for whom, so a cluster of fresh accounts vouching only for each other stands out and earns no trust until it survives costly time in the system.
